intent: Development experiment; no world-first novelty or leaderboard improvement claim.
training: None; original frozen watehell checkpoint pair with hashes verified against previous competition inference.
static_reference: Mean of six complete raters R1,R2,R3,R4,R6,R7; im_07 excluded because of exact historical training overlap. Available-rater mean is a sensitivity analysis.
static_independence: Development only: upstream explicitly used OSF benchmark; unknown participant IDs and incompletely audited upstream training.
dynamic_reference: 84 even-numbered manually annotated frames from one GM video. PA and ruler-calibrated FL only; no MT. No frame-level inferential CI.
comparators: public single-pair per-image decoder: original scalar settings, texture weight0.5, FL factor0.9, sine mixture0.25, inherited range clips; known physical benchmark scale; no temporal pooling
endpoint geometry with unmodified public boundary fits
endpoint geometry with Huber inner-boundary refits

new_geometry.boundary_fit: Huber IRLS 1.345, max30 iterations; quadratic if width>15mm else linear
new_geometry.boundary_extrapolation_limit: one shared observed horizontal field of view
new_geometry.fascicle_selection: up to3 valid lines; insertion separation>=5% shared span; maximize count then minimize total extrapolation
new_geometry.aggregation: arithmetic mean of selected endpoint PA/FL; vertical thickness mean

evaluation: Report coverage, all-case baseline fallback deployment behavior and matched-case errors; failures may not be silently dropped. Static bootstrap is descriptive image-level only because participant IDs are unknown. Dynamic frames are one dependent sequence, not independent observations.
promotion_gate: Do not replace the previous candidate automatically. A new experimental CSV can be retained with validity/fallback audit; competition score remains unknown until a separately authorized submission. No tuning against test predictions or public leaderboard.
